[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]
== Biography ==
James Glasgow married Margaret Rae on 24 Jul 1718 at West Or Old Parish, Greenock, Renfrew, Scotland.<ref name="anc1323929">[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/60144/records/1323929 Ancestry, Scotland, Select Marriages, 1561-1910, James Glasgow, 24 Jul 1718, West Or Old Parish, Greenock, Renfrew, Scotland]. Ancestry index transcript inspected 2026-11-04; original source uninspected.</ref>

=== Preferred existing couple ===
The preferred match for this groom is [[Glasgow-4158|James Glasgow of the Irvine Rae household]], at 85% subjective confidence in the couple identity. Both James Glasgow and Margaret Rae match the parents of the Irvine child baptised 11 April 1721; this is stronger than the earlier generic candidates matching only given names. The original Greenock register (FHL film 1041063) remains uninspected, and other same-name adults are retained. No separate person is recommended, no merge is made and no father is identified by this marriage.<ref>[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/60144/records/1323929 Ancestry, Scotland Select Marriages, James Glasgow and Margaret Rae, 24 July 1718, Greenock]; [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=SCOT%2FOPR%2FBAP%2F3573667&tab=this Findmypast, Irvine baptism 11 April 1721, James Glasgow and Margaret Rae]. Index evidence only.</ref>
